description:
Read a public RS3 character's complete RuneMetrics quest journal. Use recommend_next_activity for paid advice, get_player_stats for levels, or get_wiki_entity_facts with kind=quest for one quest's metadata.

- username is the character's display name, not a Jagex login, account ID or quest name. No signed-in-player default exists; ask which character when unknown.
- Send {"username":"A B"}, not {"username":"A%20B"}. The server trims outer whitespace and encodes the name once. The returned username echoes that input; no alias or canonical-identity lookup is performed.
- No gameMode or quest/status selector applies. Filter the complete returned journal locally; there is no pagination. A quest's members flag does not establish current account membership.
- Invalid names, private/unavailable or malformed journals return isError/text, not an empty journal or guessed progress.
- Sends the display name to Jagex RuneMetrics for one fresh uncached read, with a 12-second default deadline and no automatic retry. No Jev, API key, login or game changes. HTTP shares 60 requests/IP/minute by default; honor Retry-After on 429.
name: get_player_quests

counts.description: Counts over the returned journal: completed + started + notStarted equals total.

fetchedAt.description: UTC retrieval time for this uncached journal

quests.description: Complete journal entries returned by RuneMetrics

members.description: Whether this quest requires membership; not the account membership state

status.description: Reported player progress for this quest

title.description: Quest title from the public journal

userEligible.description: Jagex eligibility flag; not independent verification of equipment, budget or every condition

username.description: Trimmed input echoed back; not a separate canonical-identity lookup

title: Get Player Quest Journal
